name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (CHF)
oneLiner: CHFSAFO is Spiko's CHF UCITS fund share, using Amundi-managed overnight total-return swaps and KYC-gated redemption at NAV.
collateral: CHF accumulation share class FR0014015LG6 of Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund. Physical securities are hedged through portfolio-wide total-return swaps, with a possible unswapped money-market UCITS sleeve. CACEIS Bank is depositary; counterparty default can expose underlying security and currency risks.
pegMechanism: CHF-denominated accumulation NAV targeting SARON + 0.50% before class fees. KYC-gated subscriptions and redemptions use daily fund NAV, a 15:00 Paris cutoff and ordinary D+1 business-day settlement. Exceptional gates, suspension and swing pricing can limit or delay exit.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact CHF share FR0014015LG6 in fund 59c2c924-ebf8-492d-a4b0-72d72ebf61e6 is proportional UCITS portfolio ownership with portfolio-wide total-return swaps, possible unswapped money-market UCITS and legal separation. The current chfSAFO API lists eight native registers, including Ethereum 0x18b5c15e5196a38a162b1787875295b76e4313fb and zero-supply Solana 6Gst8o3L5uNtkUvhEg23HpDLpYRdNQTgdn1Bc7jnCM5c. Identity, current signed inventory and exact KID support ucits-trs-fund; full NAV/collateral/default reconciliation remains unavailable.
